localChanges: City Walls now triple the strength of a city's defenders, except against Artillery and Bombers (#31).
A defender on Hills fights at double strength and on Mountains at triple, and Forest, Jungle, Swamp and River add half again.
A fortified unit now defends at one and a half times its strength, as in Civ1, rather than double. Behind City Walls, fortifying adds nothing more.
Ships get no help from terrain at sea or in an unwalled city. In port behind City Walls, they get the walls and the city's terrain. Aircraft get neither.
Computer players now weigh terrain, City Walls and fortified defenders before they attack.
